segments.title: Your license can live in your iPhone
segments.say: Your driver's license can live in Apple Wallet, in sixteen US states.

segments.title: Is your state on the list?
segments.say: Arizona, California, Georgia, Ohio, and twelve more.

segments.title: 3 more states are next
segments.say: Connecticut, North Carolina and Utah are next.

segments.title: Flying? Keep your real card
segments.say: TSA takes it at some checkpoints. Keep your real card.
